title: pm-dispatch: a stateless tracking parent cannot be written — label-write and seat-lifecycle disagree
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

## What happened

On 11-27 the seat turned #36253 into the tracking parent of the ADR-0162 build (children #37766–#37774). The skill says a parent like that carries no pm state:

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md:55`: 「父单挂 `tracking`+`area:*`,无 pm 状态标签,永不派发」.

But `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` enforces the stateless rule from `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md:10` (「开着的卡离手恒落一态」) on every open card, with no exception for `tracking`. Taking the last pm state off the open #36253 was refused before the transport, zero writes.

The seat worked around it: #36253 now carries `tracking` + `pm:blocked`, with a `Blocked-by:` line naming all eight children (comment 7207678152). That keeps it out of dispatch, but it is not the shape the skill describes, and patrol now reads #36253 as a parked card waiting on eight upstreams.

## The fix (pick one, in one PR)

- **A.** label-write lets an open card that carries `tracking` hold no pm state (the stateless guard skips it, and a `tracking` card still may not take `pm:dispatched`). Add a battery case for both.
- **B.** The skill changes instead: a tracking parent carries `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` its children, and seat-lifecycle.md:55 and triage-duties.md:78 say so.

The seat leans A: it keeps the skill's existing meaning, and patrol's blocked-card reads stay about real upstreams.

## Done when

- label-write and the skill agree on one shape for a tracking parent, with a self-test case pinning it.
- #36253 is moved to that shape.
